standard-dialogue-at-ardougne-zoo-before.player: Hello. Do you need any help? I'm looking for a quest.

standard-dialogue-at-ardougne-zoo-before.text: If player has a construction level below 34:

steps.npc: I'm looking for an experienced adventurer and you're not it. Come back when you are more capable.

steps.text: You do not meet all of the requirements to start the Cold War quest.

standard-dialogue-at-ardougne-zoo-before.player: Uh, I'm not sure. Who are they?
Seriously, what are you talking about?

standard-dialogue-at-ardougne-zoo-before.npc: I think you can be trusted. What do you know about...

standard-dialogue-at-ardougne-zoo-before.player: Uh...they live in the cold? That's about all.

standard-dialogue-at-ardougne-zoo-before.npc: Would you like to learn more about them? I'm conducting a, uh, research project, to, uh, learn about their social habits in their natural environment.

standard-dialogue-at-ardougne-zoo-before.player: What do you need my help for?

standard-dialogue-at-ardougne-zoo-before.npc: Well, I need to build a shelter to hide from view, and it's always useful to have an extra pair of eyes, you know, for, uh, observing...Penguins.
So, are you up for it?

steps.player: Okay, why not! But first, who are you and why are you researching penguins?

steps.npc: I, uh, was a zoo keeper here. But, I, uh, am on leave to go research penguins in their native habitat.

steps.player: Ok! Okay then. So, what did you need me to do?

steps.npc: Right. I need you to gather materials for the bird hide, while I arrange for our transport.
You need to get 10 oak planks, 10 steel nails, a hammer, and a spade so that we can build a bird hide.
Once you have those, meet me up by the entrance to Keldagrim, east of Rellekka. I'll be there with a boat to take us to our destination.

steps.player: Right, oak planks, steel nails, hammer, spade, east of Rellekka. Got it.

steps.text: You've started a new quest: Cold War

standard-dialogue-at-rellekka-boat-befor.npc: What? Did you come to tell me I'm crazy too?
Oh, I don't have time for your lies. Go away
Sorry, you can't use this boat.

standard-dialogue-at-rellekka-boat-after.npc: I can't speak right now. I have too much to do. I will contact you when the time is right.
